senses.gloss: खचर m. 1. a bird; 2. a demon; 3. the sun; 4. the wind; 5. a cloud.
खच् (I) vi. 9P (pp. खचित) 1. To purify; 2. to come forth, to appear; 3. to be born again.
खच् (II) vt. 10U (pp. खचित) To fasten, to bind, to set.With उद्-, to intermix, to intermingle, R.viii.53, xiii.54.
खचित a. (f. ता) 1. Fastened, joined, e.g. शकुंतनीडखचितं विभज्जटामंडलम् Sak.vii.; 2. mixed, blended; 3. inlaid, set, studded (as in मणिखचित).
खचित a. (f. ता) 1. Fastened, joined, e.g. शकुंतनीडखचितं विभज्जटामंडलम् Sak.vii.; 2. mixed, blended; 3. inlaid, set, studded (as in मणिखचित).
